title: Detecting Inconsistencies in Model Specifications with LLM-as-Verifier Reasoning
title_zh: 以LLM作为验证器推理检测模型规格中的不一致性

paragraphs.en: Model specifications define how large language models (LLMs) should behave, guiding alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation. Yet these specifications may themselves contain defects: two individually reasonable principles may prescribe incompatible behavior when applied to the same situation, leaving no response that satisfies both. Detecting such inconsistencies is challenging. Formalizing natural-language specifications risks losing subtle distinctions, while behavior-based testing cannot reliably distinguish specification defects from differences in model behavior. We introduce VeriSpec , the first approach to directly detect inconsistencies in model specifications by auditing the specification text itself. Our key insight is to preserve the specification in natural language while using an LLM as a verifier. VeriSpec extracts structured, context-aware rules, constructs a topic-guided graph to cluster behaviorally related rules at the same authority level, and applies LLM-as-verifier reasoning to detect inconsistencies. Applying VeriSpec to the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and manually validate five inconsistencies, all reported to its developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec identifies the most validated inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision (38.5%), and incurs the lowest cost per validated inconsistency ($11.12). These results establish direct specification auditing as a practical complement to behavioral alignment evaluation, catching defects at the source before they shape any model. The code is available at https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec .
paragraphs.zh: 模型规范定义了大型语言模型（LLM）应如何运行，为对齐训练、推理时的行为以及评估提供了指导。 然而，这些规范本身可能也存在缺陷：两个单独来看都合理的原则，在应用于同一情境时可能会规定相互不兼容的行为，导致没有任何响应能同时满足两者。 检测此类不一致性极具挑战性。 将自然语言规范形式化的过程可能会丢失细微的差别，而基于行为的测试则无法可靠地区分规范缺陷与模型行为差异。 我们提出了 VeriSpec——首个通过直接审查规范文本本身来检测模型规范中不一致性的方法。 我们的核心思路是保留自然语言形式的规范，同时利用 LLM 作为验证工具。 VeriSpec 会提取结构化且具备上下文感知的规则，构建一个以主题为导向的图来对行为相关的规则进行同级聚类，并应用“LLM 作为验证器”的推理方法检测不一致性。 我们将 VeriSpec 应用于 OpenAI 模型规范，从中提取了 405 条规则，并手动验证了其中五个不一致性。所有问题均已报告给其开发者，他们对此作出了积极回应，并已启动内部讨论。 与五种基线方法相比，VeriSpec 识别出的经验证的不一致性问题最多，精确度最高（38.5%），且每条经验证的不一致性问题平均成本最低（11.12 美元）。 这些结果表明，直接进行规范审查是行为对齐评估的有效补充，能够在缺陷影响任何模型之前，从源头将其捕获。 代码可在 https://github.com/HIPREL-Group/VeriSpec 获取。

paragraphs.en: Model specifications have become a central interface for describing how LLMs should behave. They state requirements for usefulness, style, safety, security, and legal compliance, and they guide alignment training, inference-time behavior, and evaluation ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Wolfe, 2026 ) . Some providers publish these requirements for external review: OpenAI provides the Model Spec ( OpenAI, 2026d ) and Anthropic provides Claude’s Constitution ( Anthropic, 2026c ) . We refer to such documents as model specs . As models and deployment expectations change, these documents are frequently updated ( OpenAI, 2025b ; Anthropic, 2026d ) , making systematic review increasingly important.
paragraphs.zh: 模型规格已成为描述大型语言模型（LLM）应如何行为的中心接口。 它们规定了实用性、风格、安全性、合规性和法律遵从性的要求，并指导对齐训练、推理时的行为以及评估（Bai 等，2022；Guan 等，2025；Wolfe，2026）。 一些提供商会发布这些要求以供外部审查：OpenAI 提供了《模型规格》（OpenAI，2026d），Anthropic 则提供了 Claude 的《宪法》（Anthropic，2026c）。 我们将此类文档称为模型规格。 随着模型和部署预期的变化，这些文档会频繁更新（OpenAI，2025b；Anthropic，2026d），这使得系统性的审查变得日益重要。

paragraphs.en: As model specs grow, they become difficult to audit manually. A principle may be clear in isolation yet prescribe incompatible behavior once another applicable principle enters the picture, and the interacting passages may appear in different sections, depend on authority levels, or be mediated by exceptions, examples, and other contextual instructions. Model specs also differ from conventional natural-language requirements: they govern open-ended interactions, so an inconsistency may surface only when several principles are applied to the same concrete situation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Buyl et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着模型规格的复杂程度增加，手动审计这些规格变得越来越困难。 某项原则在单独考察时可能清晰明确，但一旦引入另一项适用的原则，它就可能规定出相互冲突的行为；而相互作用的条款可能出现在不同章节中，取决于权限级别，或受到例外情况、示例及其他上下文说明的影响。 模型规格也与传统的自然语言要求有所不同：它们管理着开放式的交互，因此只有当多个原则被应用于同一具体情境时，矛盾之处才可能显现出来（Zhang et al., 2025 ; Buyl et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows an example inconsistency in the OpenAI Model Spec. One principle asks the model to leave unrequested parts of user-provided text unchanged during transformations; another requires that code intended for execution be runnable. A request for explanatory comments with code-only output triggers both: preserving the code leaves a syntax error, while fixing the syntax changes content the user did not ask to change. Neither principle is defective on its own—the inconsistency appears only when both apply to the same situation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 OpenAI 模型规范中的一个不一致性示例。 一项原则要求模型在转换过程中保留用户提供的文本中未请求的部分不变；另一项原则则要求用于执行的代码必须能够运行。 一个要求仅输出代码并附带解释性注释的请求同时触发了这两项原则：保留原代码会导致语法错误，而修复语法则会改变用户并未要求修改的内容。 这两项原则本身并无缺陷——不一致性仅在两者同时适用于同一情况时才会出现。

paragraphs.en: A natural route to detecting such inconsistencies is to translate the specification into a formal language and apply a formal verifier ( Merigoux et al., 2021 ; Giannakopoulou et al., 2020 ; Cosler et al., 2023 ) . For model specs, however, translation is precisely where meaning is lost: the text leans on modal distinctions, e.g., may , must , should , and on permissions, defaults, exceptions, and soft obligations that formal languages flatten ( Merigoux et al., 2021 ; Guitton et al., 2025 ) . Automating the translation invites errors on exactly these distinctions, while performing it manually at the scale of a full specification requires substantial expert effort ( Yen et al., 2021 ; Giannakopoulou et al., 2020 ; Cosler et al., 2023 ) . Our key insight is to invert the approach: keep the specification in natural language and use an LLM as the verifier, so that the distinctions formalization discards become evidence the verifier reasons over.
paragraphs.zh: 检测此类不一致性的自然方法是，将规范翻译成形式化语言，并应用形式化验证器（Merigoux 等人，2021；Giannakopoulou 等人，2020；Cosler 等人，2023）。 然而，对于模型规范而言，翻译恰恰是意义丢失的环节：文本依赖于模态差异（例如 may、must、should），以及形式化语言会简化的权限、默认设置、例外和软性义务（Merigoux 等人，2021；Guitton 等人，2025）。 自动化翻译恰恰容易在这些差异上引入错误，而在全规模规范中手动执行则需要大量专家投入（Yen 等人，2021；Giannakopoulou 等人，2020；Cosler 等人，2023）。 我们的关键洞见是反转这一方法：保留自然语言形式的规范，并使用大型语言模型作为验证器，这样形式化过程所舍弃的差异就能成为验证器推理的依据。

paragraphs.en: To realize this insight, we make the text checkable by splitting the specification into rules , still in natural language, each recording a principle’s source annotation, authority level, precondition, and postcondition. Two obstacles remain. First, inconsistency is a property of rules in context : worked examples, explicit exceptions, and trade-off guidance elsewhere in the specification routinely dissolve apparent conflicts between bare rule statements, so a verifier shown only the statements reports tensions the document already resolves. Second, verifying rules pairwise is quadratic in the rule inventory, and most pairs govern unrelated behavior, so nearly all verifier calls would be spent confirming that nothing interacts. We therefore attach to each rule the context needed to interpret it, and cluster behaviorally related rules—by the topics of behavior they govern—into compact analysis units at the same authority level (the specification’s chain of command already adjudicates conflicts across levels). Each verifier call then reasons over a focused set of potentially interacting rules rather than a long document in which the relevant passages are easily lost ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为实现这一洞见，我们将规范拆分为规则，使文本具备可验证性；这些规则仍以自然语言呈现，每条规则均记录某一原则的来源标注、权限级别、前提条件和后置条件。但仍有两个障碍存在。 首先，不一致性是规则在特定语境中的固有属性：规范中其他部分的实例演示、明确例外和权衡指导通常会消解纯粹规则陈述之间的表面冲突，因此，若验证器仅看到这些陈述，就会报告出文档本身早已解决的矛盾。 其次，逐对验证规则会导致验证次数随规则数量呈二次方增长，而大多数规则组合所约束的行为并无关联，因此几乎所有的验证器调用都将耗费在确认“无相互作用”上。 因此，我们为每条规则附加了理解其含义所需的语境，并按其行为所约束的主题，将行为相关的规则聚类为权限级别一致的紧凑型分析单元（规范的指挥链已能裁定不同层级间的冲突）。 这样一来，每次验证器调用只需针对一组可能相互作用的规则进行推理，而非面对一份冗长文档——在后者中，相关段落极易被忽略（Liu et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce VeriSpec , to our knowledge the first approach to directly detect defects in model specifications—in particular, inconsistencies among their stated principles. VeriSpec realizes the design above in three stages: context-aware rule extraction builds the rule inventory together with each rule’s interpretive context; graph-based rule clustering forms same-authority analysis units over a topic-guided rule graph; and LLM-as-verifier detection reasons over each unit, reporting an inconsistency only when it can produce a concrete witness situation, explain why both rules apply, and show that their combined context does not resolve the conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 VeriSpec——据我们所知，这是首个能够直接检测模型规范中缺陷的方法，特别是其所述原则之间的不一致性。 VeriSpec 通过三个阶段实现上述设计：上下文感知规则提取负责构建规则库以及每条规则的解读上下文；基于图的规则聚类则围绕主题引导的规则图形成具有相同权威性的分析单元；而 LLM 作为验证器的检测阶段会对每个单元进行推理，仅当它能够生成具体的见证情境、解释为何两条规则同时适用，并证明其合并后的上下文无法解决冲突时，才会报告不一致性。

sents.zh: 我们提出 VeriSpec——据我们所知，这是首个能够直接检测模型规范中缺陷的方法，特别是其所述原则之间的不一致性。

sents.en: VeriSpec realizes the design above in three stages: context-aware rule extraction builds the rule inventory together with each rule’s interpretive context; graph-based rule clustering forms same-authority analysis units over a topic-guided rule graph; and LLM-as-verifier detection reasons over each unit, reporting an inconsistency only when it can produce a concrete witness situation, explain why both rules apply, and show that their combined context does not resolve the conflict.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate VeriSpec on the OpenAI Model Spec ( OpenAI, 2026d ) . VeriSpec extracts 405 rules, constructs 32 analysis units, and reports 13 candidate inconsistencies after five verifier attempts. Manual validation confirms five across legal constraints, code transformations, output-only tasks, fictional portrayals, and sycophantic reassurance. We reported all five to the OpenAI Model Spec developers, who responded positively and have initiated internal discussions. Compared with five baselines, VeriSpec validates the most inconsistencies, achieves the highest precision at 38.5%, and has the lowest cost per validated inconsistency at $11.12.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OpenAI Model Spec（OpenAI，2026d）上对 VeriSpec 进行了评估。 VeriSpec 提取了 405 条规则，构建了 32 个分析单元，并在五次验证器尝试后报告了 13 处潜在的不一致之处。 人工验证确认了其中五处问题，分别涉及法律约束、代码转换、仅输出任务、虚构描绘和阿谀奉承式安慰。 我们将这五个问题全部报告给了 OpenAI Model Spec 的开发人员，他们给予了积极回应，并已启动内部讨论。 与五个基线方法相比，VeriSpec 验证出的不一致之处最多，精度最高（38.5%），且每处验证不一致的平均成本最低（11.12 美元）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating Model Alignment. A model specification describes the intended behavior of models, not the behavior deployed systems exhibit, so alignment to a specification is typically evaluated empirically after deployment. Ahmed et al. (2025) audit models against provider specifications by parsing behavioral statements, generating targeted prompts, and using models as judges. OpenAI similarly provides an evaluation pipeline and prompt dataset for measuring adherence to the Model Spec ( Guo and Wolfe, 2026 ) . Jakkli et al. (2026) study whether models follow their provider specifications across generations, and Wang et al. (2026) synthesize specification-alignment data to improve model behavior. All of these works take the specification as ground truth and ask whether models comply with it. We invert the question: we treat the specification itself as the object of analysis and ask whether that ground truth is internally consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 评估模型对齐性。 模型规范描述的是模型的预期行为，而非部署系统实际表现出的行为，因此通常需要在部署后通过实证方法评估模型与规范的契合度。Ahmed 等人 (2025) 通过解析行为陈述、生成针对性提示，并利用模型作为评判者，对模型是否符合提供商的规范进行了审计。 OpenAI 同样提供了一个评估流程和一个提示数据集，用于衡量模型对《模型规范》的遵循程度（Guo 和 Wolfe, 2026）。Jakkli 等人 (2026) 研究了模型在不同版本迭代中是否持续遵循其提供商的规范，而 Wang 等人 (2026) 则通过合成规范对齐数据来改进模型行为。 所有这些研究都将规范视为基准事实，并探究模型是否符合该规范。 我们则反过来思考这个问题：我们将规范本身作为分析对象，探究这一基准事实是否具备内在一致性。

paragraphs.en: Value Conflicts in Model Behavior. A second line of work studies how models prioritize competing values. Buyl et al. (2025) show that arbitrary behavioral-value annotations can lead models away from human discretion, while Liu et al. (2026) use value-conflict scenarios to test prioritization and show that detailed value rankings can improve alignment. These papers ask how models behave when values compete; we ask a prior question: whether the written specification prescribes incompatible behavior in the first place, before it is used to train, evaluate, or guide any model.

paragraphs.en: Behavior-Based Specification Testing. The closest line of work uses model behavior to stress-test the specification itself. Zhang et al. (2025) generate value-tradeoff scenarios, measure disagreement across frontier LLMs, and evaluate OpenAI models against the OpenAI Model Spec, showing that behavioral disagreement can surface possible specification issues. This signal, however, is indirect and can err in both directions. The Model Spec and deployed models evolve on separate schedules, and the specification version used to train or align a given model is unknown ( OpenAI, 2026b ) ; OpenAI itself notes that deployed behavior may diverge from the Model Spec ( OpenAI, 2025a ) . A behavioral disagreement may therefore reflect training, alignment, or capability differences rather than a specification defect ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Guo and Wolfe, 2026 ; Jakkli et al., 2026 ) —and, conversely, a defect that models happen to resolve the same way produces no disagreement to observe. To our knowledge, VeriSpec is the first approach to detect model specification defects directly: it audits the specification text rather than the behavior it induces, and reports concrete inconsistencies supported by structured verifier reasoning and manual validation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于行为的规范测试。最接近的研究方向是利用模型行为对规范本身进行压力测试。Zhang 等人（2025）生成了价值权衡场景，测量了前沿 LLM 之间的分歧，并将 OpenAI 模型与 OpenAI 模型规范进行了对比，结果表明，行为分歧可能暴露出潜在的规范问题。然而，这种信号是间接的，且可能在两个方向上出现偏差。模型规范和已部署模型的演进遵循不同的时间表，而用于训练或对特定模型进行对齐的规范版本也未知（OpenAI，2026b）；OpenAI 本身也指出，已部署的行为可能与模型规范存在差异（OpenAI，2025a）。因此，行为分歧可能反映的是训练、对齐或能力上的差异，而非规范缺陷（Ahmed 等人，2025；Guo 和 Wolfe，2026；Jakkli 等人，2026）——反之亦然，如果模型恰好以相同方式解决了某个缺陷，则不会产生可观察到的分歧。据我们所知，VeriSpec 是首个能够直接检测模型规范缺陷的方法：它审查的是规范文本本身，而非其引发的行为，并报告了由结构化验证器推理和人工验证所支持的明确不一致性。

paragraphs.en: VeriSpec detects internal inconsistencies in model specifications through the three-stage pipeline shown in Figure 3 . Context-aware rule extraction (Section 4.1 ) makes the specification checkable: it converts every principle into a structured natural-language rule and attaches the context (e.g., worked examples, exceptions, trade-off guidance) needed to interpret it. Graph-based rule clustering (Section 4.2 ) makes verification tractable: over a topic-guided rule graph, it clusters behaviorally related rules into compact, same-authority analysis units, so verifier calls are spent only where rules can genuinely interact. LLM-as-verifier detection (Section 4.3 ) holds every report to a burden of proof: an inconsistency is reported only with a concrete witness situation, a joint-unsatisfiability argument, and evidence that the combined context does not resolve the conflict.
paragraphs.zh: VeriSpec 通过图 3 所示的三阶段流程检测模型规格中的内部不一致性。 上下文感知的规则提取（第 4.1 节）使规格具备可检查性：它将每条原则转化为结构化的自然语言规则，并附加解读该规则所需的上下文（例如，工作示例、例外情况以及权衡指导）。 基于图的规则聚类（第 4.2 节）使验证变得可行：在由主题引导的规则图中，它将行为相关的规则聚类为紧凑且具有相同权威性的分析单元，从而确保验证调用仅发生在规则之间确实可能发生交互的位置。 LLM 作为验证器的检测机制（第 4.3 节）要求每一项报告都必须满足证明责任：只有当存在具体的见证情境、联合不可满足性论证，以及证明组合后的上下文无法解决冲突的证据时，才会报告不一致性。

sents.en: Context-aware rule extraction (Section 4.1 ) makes the specification checkable: it converts every principle into a structured natural-language rule and attaches the context (e.g., worked examples, exceptions, trade-off guidance) needed to interpret it.
sents.zh: 上下文感知的规则提取（第 4.1 节）使规格具备可检查性：它将每条原则转化为结构化的自然语言规则，并附加解读该规则所需的上下文（例如，工作示例、例外情况以及权衡指导）。

sents.en: Graph-based rule clustering (Section 4.2 ) makes verification tractable: over a topic-guided rule graph, it clusters behaviorally related rules into compact, same-authority analysis units, so verifier calls are spent only where rules can genuinely interact.
sents.zh: 基于图的规则聚类（第 4.2 节）使验证变得可行：在由主题引导的规则图中，它将行为相关的规则聚类为紧凑且具有相同权威性的分析单元，从而确保验证调用仅发生在规则之间确实可能发生交互的位置。

sents.en: LLM-as-verifier detection (Section 4.3 ) holds every report to a burden of proof: an inconsistency is reported only with a concrete witness situation, a joint-unsatisfiability argument, and evidence that the combined context does not resolve the conflict.
sents.zh: LLM 作为验证器的检测机制（第 4.3 节）要求每一项报告都必须满足证明责任：只有当存在具体的见证情境、联合不可满足性论证，以及证明组合后的上下文无法解决冲突的证据时，才会报告不一致性。

paragraphs.en: Anonymization. Model specifications contain many references to the corresponding model provider and its models, such as OpenAI and GPT-4.1. Proprietary LLMs often refuse to analyze model specifications in depth since these references trigger their safety guardrails. We found that anonymizing the model specification, i.e., replacing these references with synthetic names, suppresses guardrails and allows us to analyze the model specification. We used Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) to perform the anonymization, together with static checks to ensure that edits are limited to such substitutions.
paragraphs.zh: 匿名化处理。 模型规格中包含了大量对相应模型提供商及其模型的引用，例如 OpenAI 和 GPT-4.1。 专有大型语言模型通常会拒绝深入分析模型规格，因为这些引用会触发其安全护栏机制。 我们发现，对模型规格进行匿名化处理，即将这些引用替换为合成名称，可以抑制安全护栏机制，从而使我们能够分析模型规格。 我们使用 Claude Code（Anthropic, 2025）执行了匿名化处理，并结合静态检查以确保修改仅限于此类替换。

paragraphs.en: As described in Section 2 , many principles in the model spec have alphanumeric annotations called focus areas . These annotations provide anchors in the specification, allowing us to systematically cover all principles in the model spec. The model spec contains 279 annotations, but we found by manual inspection that many principles are not annotated and a small number of annotations do not even mark principles. The latter only adds a small amount of overhead during analysis, but the former limits coverage by omitting principles that may be involved in inconsistencies.

paragraphs.en: Note that a statement in the model spec is considered to be a principle if it prescribes model behavior in some situation. A statement may contain multiple principles, in which case each of them should carry its own annotation. Following this criterion, we used the existing annotations as examples to guide Claude Code in annotating the remaining principles and thus completing the annotations. We added 126 annotations, bringing the total to 405. Figure 2 shows one added annotation for our running example (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，如果模型规范中的某个陈述在特定情况下规定了模型的行为，则该陈述被视为一项原则。 一个陈述可能包含多个原则，在这种情况下，每个原则都应带有自己的注释。 遵循这一标准，我们利用现有的注释作为示例，指导 Claude Code 对剩余的原则进行注释，从而完成所有注释工作。 我们添加了 126 条注释，使总数达到 405 条。 图 2 展示了我们为运行示例添加的一条注释（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Context. Due to the open-ended manner in which principles are described, the statement of a principle may not be sufficient in itself to understand its application in practice. The model specification contains concrete examples, definitions, and guidance on trade-offs between different principles, all of which aid the interpretation of any principle. The statement of a principle, together with this relevant information from the model specification, forms the context associated with the principle. We denote this by C ​ ( r ) \textsc{C}(r) , where r r is the corresponding rule.
paragraphs.zh: 背景。 由于原则的描述方式是开放式的，仅凭对某一原则的陈述可能不足以理解其在实践中的应用。 模型规范包含了具体示例、定义以及对不同原则之间权衡的说明，这些都有助于对任何原则的解释。 某一原则的陈述，连同模型规范中的这些相关信息，共同构成了与该原则相关的背景。 我们用 C ​ ( r ) \textsc{C}(r) 表示这一背景，其中 r r 是相应的规则。

paragraphs.en: Topic derivation. A topic is a class of rules that address a common aspect of model behavior or situations, like output-format adherence or stance-taking. We use Claude Code to extract topics from the model specification by spawning multiple subagents, which independently propose topics that are then merged into a single set of topics, Δ \Delta . For every proposed topic, the main agent spawns multiple subagents to independently list the specific rules belonging to that topic. Any topic with high disagreement between subagents is considered ambiguous and is dropped. We use T ⁡ ( r ) T(r) to denote the set of topics that a rule r r belongs to.
paragraphs.zh: 主题推导。 主题是一类规则的集合，用于处理模型行为或情境中的共同方面，例如输出格式的一致性或立场表达。 我们使用 Claude Code 通过创建多个子智能体从模型规范中提取主题；这些子智能体独立提出主题，随后将这些主题合并为一个统一的主题集 Δ \Delta。 对于每个提出的主题，主智能体会创建多个子智能体，以独立列出属于该主题的具体规则。 任何子智能体之间存在高度分歧的主题都被视为模棱两可，并予以舍弃。 我们用 T ⁡ ( r ) T(r) 表示规则 r r 所属的主题集合。

paragraphs.en: Detecting inconsistencies requires examining the right rules jointly, yet interacting rules are scattered: the two principles of our running example (Figure 1 ) sit in different sections of the specification and govern different aspects of behavior (Figure 2 ). Grouping rules by document structure keeps such cross-section pairs apart, while exhaustive pairwise verification is prohibitively expensive (over 80,000 pairs for our 405-rule inventory, almost all governing unrelated behavior). We therefore construct a rule graph that records how rules relate, and use it to cluster related rules at the same authority level into compact analysis units for verification.
paragraphs.zh: 检测不一致性需要共同审视正确的规则，但相互作用的规则却分散各处：我们运行示例中的两个原则（图 1）位于规范的不同部分，并分别控制行为的不同方面（图 2）。 按照文档结构对规则进行分组会使这类跨部分的规则对彼此分离，而穷尽式的成对验证则成本高昂（对于我们包含 405 条规则的规则库而言，超过 80,000 对，其中几乎所有规则都控制着互不相关的行为）。 因此，我们构建了一个记录规则之间关联关系的规则图，并利用它将同一权限层级上的相关规则聚类为紧凑的分析单元以进行验证。

Each vertex ( r , δ ) ∈ V (r,\delta)\in V represents the assignment of rule r r to topic δ \delta . A rule assigned to multiple topics therefore contributes one vertex per topic.

paragraphs.en: Edges capture two complementary relations. A semantic edge connects two vertices assigned to the same topic, linking rules that govern the same behavior wherever they appear in the document. A syntactic edge connects vertices whose underlying rules occur in the same subsection, share a worked example, or are linked by an explicit cross-reference. These document-level ties capture relations that the topic tests may miss. We write syn ⁡ ( r , r ′ ) \mathrm{syn}(r,r^{\prime}) if r r and r ′ r^{\prime} satisfy at least one of these conditions. Edges are constructed only between distinct rules at the same authority level, because disagreements across levels are resolved by the chain of command.
paragraphs.zh: 边捕捉两种互补的关系。 语义边连接两个被分配给同一主题顶点，将文档中各处出现的、规范相同行为的规则关联起来。 句法边连接那些底层规则出现在同一小节、共享一个实例解析或通过明确交叉引用相互关联的顶点。 这些文档层面的联系捕捉到了主题测试可能遗漏的关系。 如果 r 和 r ′ 满足这些条件中的至少一个，我们记作 syn ⁡ ( r , r ′ ) \mathrm{syn}(r,r^{\prime})。 边仅在相同权威级别的不同规则之间构建，因为不同层级之间的分歧由指挥链解决。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 formalizes the clustering process; the middle stage of Figure 3 depicts it on the running example. For the OpenAI Model Spec, we extract 405 rules and derive 45 topics (Appendix B ), producing 625 rule–topic vertices. Among these rules, 162 belong to multiple topics and thus contribute multiple vertices. paragraphs.en: We use the LLM as a verifier rather than as an unconstrained inconsistency detector. We use Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) as the core verifier because it reliably follows the structured verification prompt and completes the full analysis units; GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026a ) produced similar findings at higher cost, while Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) blocked most requests under Anthropic’s restrictions on violative cyber content. For each analysis unit, the verifier receives the rules in that unit together with the context needed to interpret them. A valid report must provide evidence for Definition 3 : it must give a concrete witness situation, explain why both rules apply, and justify why the combined context does not resolve the inconsistency.

paragraphs.en: Inconsistency validation. We validate each reported inconsistency through manual inspection by two reviewers. paragraphs.en: Applying VeriSpec to the 405 extracted rules produced 32 same-authority analysis units. We ran inconsistency detection five times on each unit, yielding 160 independent detection requests. Across these runs, VeriSpec produced 17 raw inconsistency reports. After removing duplicate outputs and merging reports that described the same specification inconsistency, we obtained 13 candidate inconsistencies for manual inspection. Figure 4 shows that the cumulative number of unique candidate inconsistencies saturates at the fifth attempt, where all candidates have been found.

We have reported these 5 inconsistencies to the OpenAI Model Spec developers. Figure 1 shows the code-transformation inconsistency as the running example, and Section 5.4 presents the other four validated inconsistencies.

paragraphs.en: Whole-specification detection is not sufficient. DirectAgent and DirectPrompt give the model access to the full specification, but neither produces a validated inconsistency. They report 9 and 16 candidates respectively, all of which fail manual validation. A recurring failure mode is to report an inconsistency after reading only the apparent tension between two passages, while missing a nearby exception that resolves the pair. In one false report, the baseline treated a transformation permission as inconsistent with content prohibitions, even though the transformation passage explicitly says that the permission still applies when the transformed output would otherwise be restricted. This result shows that whole-specification access alone does not focus the model on the specific principles that may be inconsistent, and it does not force the model to check whether the surrounding context resolves a candidate inconsistency.
paragraphs.zh: 仅依赖完整规格说明的检测并不充分。 DirectAgent 和 DirectPrompt 让模型能够访问完整的规格说明，但两者都无法生成经过验证的不一致性问题。 它们分别报告了 9 个和 16 个候选问题，但所有候选问题都未通过人工验证。 一种反复出现的失败模式是：模型在仅读取两段文字之间表面上的矛盾后便报告存在不一致，却忽略了附近能够解决这一矛盾的特例说明。 在一项错误报告中，基线模型将某种转换权限与内容禁令视为相互矛盾，尽管转换相关的段落明确说明：当转换后的输出本应受到限制时，该权限仍然有效。 这一结果表明，仅凭对完整规格说明的访问，既无法让模型聚焦于可能产生矛盾的具体原则，也无法迫使模型检查周围上下文是否解决了某个候选的不一致性问题。

paragraphs.en: Section-based grouping misses cross-section cases. SectionText and SectionGroup validate only one inconsistency each, namely the legal-disclosure case whose two rules appear in the same section. They miss cases whose rules are distributed across the document, including the code-transformation case used as the running example in Figure 1 . The difference between SectionText and SectionGroup is also small, which suggests that rule extraction helps most when paired with analysis units that group rules by behavior rather than by source section.
paragraphs.zh: 基于章节的分组会遗漏跨章节的案例。 SectionText 和 SectionGroup 各自仅能验证一处不一致，即法律披露案例，其中两条规则出现在同一章节中。 它们会遗漏规则分布在文档不同部分的案例，包括图 1 中用作贯穿示例的代码转换案例。 SectionText 和 SectionGroup 之间的差异也很小，这表明规则提取在与那些按行为而非来源章节对规则进行分组的分析单元结合时效果最佳。

paragraphs.en: LLM-as-verifier detection reduces false positives. PlainDetect uses the same rule-graph units as VeriSpec but asks the LLM to report inconsistencies directly. It finds 3 validated inconsistencies, but it reports 221 candidates and achieves only 1.4% precision. Most invalid reports are resolved by specification context, including explicit exceptions, compatible joint responses, worked examples, or the chain of command. The LLM-as-verifier detection targets this failure mode by requiring a witness, an unsatisfiability argument, and a context-resolution argument before reporting. This reduces the candidate set from 221 to 13 while increasing precision from 1.4% to 38.5%.
paragraphs.zh: LLM验证器检测方法减少了误报。 PlainDetect使用与VeriSpec相同的规则图单元，但要求LLM直接报告不一致之处。 该方法发现了3个经验证的不一致情况，但报告了221个候选项，且精确率仅为1.4%。 大多数无效报告可通过规范上下文得到解决，包括明确的例外情况、兼容的联合响应、工作示例或指令链。 LLM验证器检测通过要求在报告前提供见证、不可满足性论证和上下文解析论证来针对这种失效模式。 这将候选项集合从221个减少到13个，同时将精确率从1.4%提升至38.5%。

sents.en: LLM-as-verifier detection reduces false positives.

paragraphs.en: We presented VeriSpec , an approach to directly detecting inconsistencies in natural-language model specifications through context-aware rule extraction, graph-based clustering, and LLM-as-verifier reasoning. Applied to the OpenAI Model Spec, VeriSpec identified five manually validated inconsistencies and outperformed five baselines in detection precision and cost per validated inconsistency. These findings demonstrate that systematic auditing can uncover defects in the specifications themselves, complementing existing approaches that evaluate model behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VeriSpec，这是一种通过上下文感知规则提取、基于图的聚类以及将 LLM 用作验证器的推理方式，直接检测自然语言模型规范中不一致性的方法。 在应用于 OpenAI 模型规范时，VeriSpec 识别出五个经人工验证的不一致项，并在检测精度和每个已验证不一致项的成本方面优于五种基线方法。 这些发现表明，系统化的审计能够揭示规范本身存在的缺陷，从而补充了现有评估模型行为的方法。

paragraphs.en: Our work opens a broader direction toward continuous verification and improvement of model specifications. As these specifications evolve, future research can extend beyond inconsistency detection to automated specification repair, incremental verification, and systematic auditing across different model providers. More fundamentally, our work challenges a prevailing assumption in LLM alignment: that the specifications against which models are trained and evaluated can themselves be treated as ground truth. Ensuring that models follow their specifications is only part of the challenge; ensuring that those specifications are themselves consistent is equally important.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作为模型规格的持续验证与改进开辟了一个更广泛的方向。 随着这些规格不断演进，未来的研究可以超越不一致性检测，扩展到自动化规格修复、增量验证以及对不同模型提供商的系统性审计。 从更根本的层面来看，我们的工作挑战了大型语言模型对齐领域的一个普遍假设：即模型训练和评估所依据的规格本身可以被视作绝对真理。 确保模型遵循其规格只是挑战的一部分；确保这些规格本身具有一致性同样重要。

paragraphs.en: Annotation criterion. We add a missing annotation only when the statement prescribes model behavior in a situation. This includes requirements, recommendations, prohibitions, and explicit permissions. The statement must be directed at the assistant, and the governed situation and behavior must be specific enough for compliance to be judged. Modal verbs alone are not sufficient: “the assistant may refuse” grants a permission and is therefore a principle, whereas “the assistant may encounter errors” describes a possibility and is not. We do not annotate example conversations, commentary, definitions, rationales, restatements of already annotated principles, or statements that govern parties other than the assistant. Existing focus-area annotations are preserved, so the completion pass only adds missing annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 标注标准。 仅当陈述在特定情境中规定了模型的行为时，我们才会添加缺失的标注。 这包括要求、建议、禁止和明确许可。 该陈述必须针对助手，且受规制的情境和行为必须足够具体，以便能够判断是否符合要求。 仅靠情态动词是不够的：“助手可以拒绝”授予了一项许可，因此是一项原则；而“助手可能会遇到错误”描述的是一种可能性，因此不是原则。 我们不会标注示例对话、评论、定义、理由、对已标注原则的重述，或规制除助手以外其他方的陈述。 现有的焦点领域标注将被保留，因此完成阶段仅添加缺失的标注。

paragraphs.en: Annotation granularity. We follow the granularity of the original annotations. A normative sentence is normally treated as one principle, even when it lists several coordinated actions or conditions. We split a sentence only when it states separable policies, for example when the polarity changes or when neighboring original annotations already mark parallel items separately. A qualification that narrows a principle stays with that principle, while a clause that permits otherwise restricted behavior is treated as a separate principle. In the completed annotation set, 26 sentences carry more than one annotation; 23 of these splits were already present in the original model spec.
paragraphs.zh: 标注粒度。 我们遵循原始标注的粒度。 一个规范性句子通常被视为一条原则，即使其中列出了多个并列的动作或条件。 只有当句子陈述了可分离的政策时，我们才会将其拆分，例如当句子的极性发生变化，或者相邻的原始标注已经将并列项单独标记时。 对原则进行限定的修饰语仍与该原则保持关联，而允许原本受限行为的条款则被视为一条独立的原则。 在完整的标注集中，有 26 个句子包含多条标注；其中 23 处拆分在原始模型规范中已经存在。

paragraphs.en: Rule extraction and validation. We use Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) to extract the structured fields for each completed annotation, including the precondition P P , postcondition Q Q , source statement, section path, and associated examples. We then validate the extracted inventory with static checks. The first check enforces one-to-one coverage between annotations and rules, so every annotation appears exactly once and no rule id is duplicated or missing. The second check confirms that each extracted rule remains linked to its source statement and examples, which lets later graph construction recover the context used to interpret P P and Q Q .
paragraphs.zh: 规则提取与验证。 我们使用 Claude Code（Anthropic，2025）提取每个已完成标注的结构化字段，包括前提条件 P P、后件 Q Q、源语句、路径以及相关示例。 接着，我们通过静态检查来验证所提取的规则清单。 第一项检查确保标注与规则之间实现一对一覆盖，即每个标注仅出现一次，且没有任何规则 ID 重复或缺失。 第二项检查确认每条提取出的规则仍与其源语句及示例保持关联，这样在后续的图构建过程中即可恢复用于解释 P P 和 Q Q 的上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: Topic registry. Three independent LLM subagents propose candidate topics and yes/no membership tests ( topic tests ). After merging equivalent tests, we obtain 18 candidate topics, 16 of which are proposed by all three agents. Two subagents then independently apply each test to a sample of 40 rules. We revise tests whose agreement falls below Cohen’s κ = 0.6 \kappa=0.6 and drop topics that remain below it; the only failing test improves from κ = 0.48 \kappa=0.48 to κ = 0.925 \kappa=0.925 after revision, so no topic is dropped. Uncovered rules motivate two additional topics, yielding the 20 topics in Table 4 . An independent closure pass finds no missing topic. To validate the registry against held-out evidence, we remove cross-reference links from the text shown to the agents and later check whether cross-referenced rule pairs receive shared topics. Such pairs share a topic 7.16 × 7.16\times more often than random pairs (permutation test, p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001 ). Seven topics contain more than 30 rules, so we refine them into sub-topics with the same procedure (inter-subagent κ ≥ 0.87 \kappa\geq 0.87 ). The final registry contains 45 leaf topics, consisting of 32 sub-topics and 13 unrefined topics.
paragraphs.zh: 主题注册表。 三个独立的 LLM 子智能体提出候选主题，并执行“是/否”成员资格测试（主题测试）。 合并等效的测试后，我们得到 18 个候选主题，其中 16 个由所有三个智能体共同提出。 随后，两个子智能体各自独立地将每个测试应用于 40 条规则的样本集。 我们将一致性低于 Cohen’s κ = 0.6 \kappa=0.6 的测试进行修订，并剔除仍低于该阈值的主題；唯一未通过的测试在修订后从 κ = 0.48 \kappa=0.48 提升至 κ = 0.925 \kappa=0.925，因此没有主题被剔除。 未被覆盖的规则促使我们增加两个主题，最终形成表 4 中的 20 个主题。 一次独立的闭合检查未发现任何缺失的主题。 为了验证该注册表在预留证据上的有效性，我们从展示给智能体的文本中移除了交叉引用链接，随后检查被交叉引用的规则对是否共享相同主题。 这类规则对共享主题的概率比随机配对高 7.16 × 7.16\times（置换检验，p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001）。 有七个主题包含超过 30 条规则，因此我们采用相同流程将其细分为子主题（子智能体间 κ ≥ 0.87 \kappa\geq 0.87）。 最终注册表包含 45 个叶主题，由 32 个子主题和 13 个未细分的主题组成。

sents.en: To validate the registry against held-out evidence, we remove cross-reference links from the text shown to the agents and later check whether cross-referenced rule pairs receive shared topics.

sents.en: Such pairs share a topic 7.16 × 7.16\times more often than random pairs (permutation test, p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001 ).

sents.en: Seven topics contain more than 30 rules, so we refine them into sub-topics with the same procedure (inter-subagent κ ≥ 0.87 \kappa\geq 0.87 ).
sents.zh: 有七个主题包含超过 30 条规则，因此我们采用相同流程将其细分为子主题（子智能体间 κ ≥ 0.87 \kappa\geq 0.87）。

sents.en: The final registry contains 45 leaf topics, consisting of 32 sub-topics and 13 unrefined topics.
sents.zh: 最终注册表包含 45 个叶主题，由 32 个子主题和 13 个未细分的主题组成。

paragraphs.en: Topic assignment. Applying the membership tests to the 405 rules produces 625 rule–topic nodes. A total of 162 rules receive more than one topic because they govern multiple behaviors. For 21 rules, no test fits clearly. We record these rules as residue and assign each one to its closest topic so that every rule remains covered. Most residue rules describe how conflicts between instructions are resolved, which the registry excludes by design.
paragraphs.zh: 主题分配。 将成员资格测试应用于这 405 条规则，可生成 625 个规则–主题节点。 共有 162 条规则获得了不止一个主题，因为它们管理着多种行为。 对于 21 条规则，没有任何测试能明确匹配。 我们将这些规则记录为余数，并将每条规则分配给其最接近的主题，以确保所有规则都有归属。 大多数余数规则描述了如何解决指令之间的冲突，而注册表在设计上排除了这种情况。

paragraphs.en: Analysis units. Table 3 summarizes the resulting graph. Grouping nodes by authority and topic initially produces 113 non-empty groups. The groups are uneven, with 101 groups containing fewer than 12 nodes and many containing only one or two rules. Such small groups give the verifier few rules to compare while still requiring a separate request. We therefore merge small groups within each authority level. Each group below 12 nodes is merged into the same-authority group with which it shares the most rules and graph edges, as long as the merged group has at most 28 nodes. This produces the 32 analysis units used in the experiments, with 14 at the root level, 8 at the user level, 8 at the guideline level, and one each at the system and developer levels.
paragraphs.zh: 分析单元。 表 3 总结了由此生成的图。 最初按权限和主题对节点进行分组，产生了 113 个非空组。 这些组的规模不均衡：其中 101 个组的节点数少于 12 个，许多组甚至只包含一条或两条规则。 这类小组使得验证者可供比较的规则很少，但仍需要单独发起请求。 因此，我们将每个权限层级内的小组进行合并。 每个节点数少于 12 的组，都会与在相同权限层级下共享最多规则和图边的组进行合并，前提是合并后的组最多包含 28 个节点。 这样便得到了实验中使用的 32 个分析单元：根层级有 14 个，用户层级有 8 个，指南层级有 8 个，系统和开发者层级各有 1 个。

paragraphs.en: All methods use Claude Opus 5 and run for five independent attempts, matching the detection budget used by VeriSpec . For direct LLM calls, we use high reasoning effort. DirectAgent is instantiated with Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, so it differs from the other baselines in execution but not in the model used.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法均使用 Claude Opus 5，并运行五次独立尝试，与 VeriSpec 使用的检测预算一致。 对于直接调用 LLM 的情况，我们采用高推理强度。 DirectAgent 是使用 Claude Code（由 Claude Opus 5 驱动）实例化的，因此它在执行方式上与其他基线方法不同，但所用模型相同。

sents.zh: 所有方法均使用 Claude Opus 5，并运行五次独立尝试，与 VeriSpec 使用的检测预算一致。

sents.zh: 对于直接调用 LLM 的情况，我们采用高推理强度。

sents.zh: DirectAgent 是使用 Claude Code（由 Claude Opus 5 驱动）实例化的，因此它在执行方式上与其他基线方法不同，但所用模型相同。

paragraphs.en: DirectAgent and DirectPrompt . Both whole-specification baselines receive the anonymized specification once per attempt and do not receive extracted rules, analysis units, or the structured fields required by LLM-as-verifier detection. DirectAgent starts each attempt from a fresh Claude Code session and asks the agent to find internal inconsistencies. DirectPrompt uses a single non-agentic LLM call with the same whole-specification input and task instruction.
paragraphs.zh: DirectAgent 和 DirectPrompt。 两种完整规格基线方法在每次尝试中仅接收一次匿名化后的完整规格，且不会收到提取出的规则、分析单元或 LLM-as-verifier 检测所需的结构化字段。 DirectAgent 在每次尝试时都从一个新的 Claude Code 会话开始，并让智能体查找内部矛盾之处。 DirectPrompt 使用单次非智能体的 LLM 调用，输入为相同的完整规格和任务说明。

paragraphs.en: SectionText . This baseline removes rule extraction and applies LLM-as-verifier detection directly to source text. We split the specification at second-level headings into 42 units, each consisting of one section with its subsections and examples, and remove annotation tags from the input. The prompt includes the same inconsistency definition and authority background used by VeriSpec . Because the text contains no rule identifiers, the model identifies the relevant statements by quoting them.
paragraphs.zh: 章节文本。 该基线方法移除了规则提取，并将 LLM 作为验证器的检测直接应用于源文本。 我们将规格说明按二级标题拆分为 42 个单元，每个单元包含一个章节及其子章节和示例，并从输入中移除注释标签。 提示词包含了 VeriSpec 使用的相同不一致性定义和权威背景信息。 由于文本中不包含规则标识符，模型通过引用相关陈述来识别这些陈述。

paragraphs.en: Candidate consolidation. We normalize outputs in the same way for all methods. We first remove duplicate reports of the same rule or statement pair across attempts and units, and then merge reports that describe the same specification inconsistency. The merged candidates are the reported inconsistencies in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 候选项合并。 我们对所有方法都以相同的方式对输出进行归一化。 我们首先移除不同尝试和单位中针对同一规则或陈述对的重叠报告，然后合并描述相同规范不一致性的报告。 合并后的候选项即表 1 中报告的不一致项。
